content: Python 3.10 documents strings as sequences of Unicode code points where each code point has length 1, so len(str) supplies the project-selected character accounting. The built-in dict is mutable, len(d) returns its item count, and adding an already-present key replaces the associated value. Sources: https://docs.python.org/3.10/reference/datamodel.html and https://docs.python.org/3.10/library/stdtypes.html
